name: Web Search
description: Searches the web via Tavily to discover pages, or scrapes website content, sanitizes HTML, resolves hyperlinks, and reads article text.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.label: Operation Mode
inputs.helpText: Choose between querying the web to discover relevant pages, or fetching and extracting content from a known URL.

inputs.name: query
inputs.label: Search Query
inputs.placeholder: e.g. latest AI research benchmarks or {{input.topic}}
inputs.helpText: The search query string to look up relevant web pages.

inputs.name: provider
inputs.label: Search Provider
inputs.helpText: Search engine provider to execute web search queries (defaults to Tavily).

inputs.name: maxResults
inputs.label: Max Results
inputs.helpText: Maximum number of search results to return (1-20, default 5).

inputs.name: searchDepth
inputs.label: Search Depth
inputs.helpText: Search depth level. Basic is fast and cost-effective; Advanced performs deeper reranking.

inputs.name: topic
inputs.label: Topic Category
inputs.helpText: Target category for the search results.

inputs.name: timeRange
inputs.label: Time Range
inputs.helpText: Filter results by relative publication timeframe.

inputs.name: includeDomains
inputs.label: Include Domains
inputs.helpText: Comma-separated list of domains to restrict search results to.

inputs.name: excludeDomains
inputs.label: Exclude Domains
inputs.helpText: Comma-separated list of domains to exclude from search results.

inputs.name: includeAnswer
inputs.label: Include AI Summary Answer
inputs.helpText: If enabled, Tavily returns an LLM-generated direct answer based on search results.

inputs.name: url
inputs.label: Target URL
inputs.helpText: URL to scrape, extract links from, or read article.

inputs.name: maxContentLength
inputs.label: Max Content Length
inputs.helpText: Maximum character length of HTML/text to avoid exceeding LLM context limits.

inputs.name: engine
inputs.label: Fetch Engine
inputs.helpText: Fast fetch is ultra-fast for static content; Playwright executes client-side JavaScript.

inputs.name: cacheResult
inputs.label: Cache Last Result
inputs.helpText: Store the latest execution result in the database cache. When running in Debug mode with 'Use Cache' enabled, this cached result will be reused instead of calling the web search or scraping service.
